records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total Net sales decreased $846 million, or 14.2%, to $5,103 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023, compared to $5,949 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The decline in Net sales occurred across all operating segments, primarily driven by a decrease in hardware sales.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This increase was primarily driven by share repurchases in 2023 with no similar activity in 2022 and less inventory financing as a result of lower sales activity, partially offset by less repayments on debt due to lower borrowings.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in Gross profit margin was primarily driven by higher product margin, including notebook mix and rate, and a higher mix of netted down revenue, primarily software.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income was $355 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023, a decrease of $32 million, compared to $387 million for the three months ended March 31, 2022.
